entities.name: Access Control Checks
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE to determine if access to 5GS is allowed based on access identities and categories

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: UE state where UE is not connected to the network

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: UE state where UE has an active connection to the network

entities.name: Access Identities
entities.description: Set of standardized identities used for access control (0-15) including MPS, MCS, and Access Classes 11-15

entities.name: Access Categories
entities.description: Set of standardized and operator-defined categories used for access control

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message used for various purposes including PDU session establishment and modification

entities.name: UE operating as IAB-node
entities.description: Special condition where UE operates as Integrated Access and Backhaul node with different access control behavior

entities.name: SNPN access mode
entities.description: Condition where UE is operating in Standalone Non-Public Network access mode

entities.name: RRC inactive indication
entities.description: Condition where UE is in connected mode but with RRC inactive state

relations.description: Access control checks are performed when UE transitions from 5GMM-IDLE mode to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
Access control checks are performed for specific events in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
Access control uses access identities to determine access permissions
Access control uses access categories to determine access permissions
UL NAS TRANSPORT message triggers access control checks
UE operating as IAB-node skips access control checks but still provides access identities to lower layers
Different rules apply for access identity determination in SNPN access mode
UE provides access identities to lower layers for access attempts in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication
